alex: Night shift handoff — quick async standup:
alex: - Did: rotated oncall, trimmed noisy PagerDuty alerts, pushed temp filter to pager rule for 503 spikes, ran canary for model-serving pool B.
alex: - Blockers: still seeing intermittent 99th latency on quantized nodes; root cause unclear (maybe kernel fallback). Logs attached below.
alex: - Today: follow up with infra team on kernel update, run per-model latency profile, and finish the rollback PR if needed.
maria: thanks — can you paste the alert IDs? I want to add noise suppression rules in alertmanager.
kevin: @alex pinged on the rollback PR — I left comments about flaky test in integration. If you rebase I'll merge.
alex: alert ids: pagerduty PD12345, PD12346; alertmanager rule name: inference_503_spike; small snippet:
```yaml
- alert: Inference503Spike
  expr: increase(inference_requests{status="503"}[5m]) > 10
  labels: {severity="page"}
```
sara: oncall update: handled two pages, both resolved by autoscale. Noticed trace for one request stuck in KV cache eviction — filed ticket #678.
oncall-bot: incident created -> INC-2026 linked to ticket #678 by sara
maria: i'll tune alertmanager — adding 10m suppression window for noisy endpoints. Also adding annotation to include model name in alerts.
kevin: small note — can we add a quick smoke test to catch the KV cache eviction locally? I can pair after standup.
alex: sounds good. @kevin can you review my PR after rebase? I'll also try a kernel revert on a staging node.
deploy-bot: deploy phase: model-serving/staging rolled back to v1.2.8 — success :white_check_mark:
sara: thanks all — no open pages now. leaving for handoff in ~30m.
maria: I'll follow up on alertmanager changes and send the config diff in #eng-infra.
alex: thanks team — will post results of kernel revert here. :thumbsup:
